svg.title: YouSpeed map-bundle coverage in Western Europe
svg.desc: All 51 supported map bundles are shown. Coral marks bundles in countries with an embedded on-device traffic-sign-recognition pack.
svg.text: Western Europe · current checked-in release targets
Coral = an embedded on-device TSR pack; blue = map bundle coverage.
Boundaries are buffered Geofabrik extract coverage, not authoritative national borders.
